title: Ninkondi Prime
extract:
The Ninkondi Prime is the primed variant of the  Ninkondi Tenno Nunchaku, sporting overall higher stats and added physical damage, at some expense to its  Electricity damage. Ninkondi Prime was released alongside  Wukong Prime and  Zhuge Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Electricity damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Atlantis Vulcan and  Mafic Rain (Conclave only) stance.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest critical chance, critical multiplier, and status chance of all nunchaku.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On May 11th, 2021, it was announced that Ninkondi Prime, along with  Wukong Prime and  Zhuge Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on May 25th, 2021. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.
